per_file.purpose: Protocol constants and command frame builders.
per_file.reviewed_hunks: Reviewed 0x87 and adjacent CP4C/CP4D protocol definitions. CMD_ORDINARY_KEY_READBACK remains 0x87, CMD_SIDE_SWITCH_CONFIG remains 0x97, CMD_SLEEP_WAIT_TIME remains 0x95, and CMD_FIRMWARE_CATALOG_KEY remains 0x9F. readOrdinaryKeyConfig emits one request for mode + key_index and clamps both to 0..3. The single-packet limits remain ORDINARY_KEY_READBACK_FRAME_MAX 64 and action+description budget 53. Side-switch write still enforces Custom action envelopes and the 52 byte 0x97 readback budget.

Reviewed parseOrdinaryKeyReadback. It rejects null or >64 byte frames, requires cmd 0x87 with status 0, requires payload shape mode/key_index/action_type/action_len/action_payload/desc_len/desc_payload, restricts mode and key_index to 0..3, accepts only empty 0x00, shortcut 0x73, and macro 0x74 action types, requires exact desc_len consumption, and rejects action_len + desc_len over 53. Malformed or unsupported frames fail closed rather than being guessed or truncated.

per_file.purpose: Command transaction serialization over USB HID or BLE bridge.
per_file.reviewed_hunks: Reviewed 0x9F catalog key read, 0x97 side-switch read/write, 0x87 ordinary-key readback, and response waiting. readOrdinaryKeyConfig waits with throwOnDeviceError=false so explicit firmware statuses are preserved; status 3 is surfaced as a too-large single-packet readback failure. 0x97 read/write remains on CMD_SIDE_SWITCH_CONFIG. Command locking and pending-frame clearing remain consistent with existing transaction flow.

per_file.purpose: Encode/decode key actions and compare firmware readback to Windows state.
per_file.reviewed_hunks: Reviewed shortcut/macro payload encoding, side-switch Custom envelope wrapping, ordinary-key readback decode, and matchesReadback. 0x73 shortcut and 0x74 macro payloads are compared exactly; an empty firmware action 0x00 is accepted only for an expected empty shortcut. Description comparison uses the same ASCII 20-byte sanitized form as the write path.

per_file.purpose: Maintain Studio draft state and CP4C/CP4D readback baselines.
per_file.reviewed_hunks: Reviewed cp4cInputConfigEnabled, inputBaselineRevision, applyOrdinaryKeyReadback, applySideSwitchReadback, and side-switch Custom mutation. Passive readback changes update inputBaselineRevision rather than user draft revision, and ordinary-key readback does not overwrite a mode that has an unsaved draft. Side-switch edits still mark TOGGLE_SWITCH dirty and use the approved Custom/Disabled complement behavior.

per_file.purpose: Coordinate firmware capability discovery, readback, save, and verification.
per_file.reviewed_hunks: Reviewed 0x9F catalog handling, connect-time CP4C input readback, per-mode/per-key 0x87 reads, save completion behavior, and save-after-readback verification. 0x97 side-switch readback is applied independently before ordinary-key reads. 0x87 failures are logged per cmd/mode/keyIndex/phase and do not erase a successful side-switch baseline. Save verification reads back 0x97 first, then all 0x87 ordinary keys, and reports failure without clearing dirty draft state.

per_file.reviewed_hunks: Reviewed findDevicePath and related USB transport behavior as a regression check. The selector requires VID 413c, PID 2107, and mi_01. Static search found no mi_00 or col02 fallback restored for configuration traffic.

per_file.purpose: Expose CP4C side-switch Custom editing and readback status.
per_file.reviewed_hunks: Reviewed CP4C toggle group rebuild triggers and Custom shortcut/macro editors. The pane observes cp4cInputConfigEnabled and inputBaselineRevision, exposes single-key/combination shortcut/short macro editing, and keeps save responsibility in the top-level unified save flow.

Too-large status 3 and malformed success frames fail closed.
